leadText: Magoichi (Japanese: マゴイチ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.
plainText:
Magoichi (Japanese: マゴイチ) is a Warlord in Pokémon Conquest.

==In the games==
 , Magoichi, Okuni, Tadakatsu, Kanetsugu, Yukimura, Gracia and Hanbei]]
 

===Warlord information===
====Rank I====
 

====Rank II====
 

Transforms to Rank II by reaching a 60% link with Grovyle or Sceptile while at least three female Warlords are in the same kingdom, and Masamune is not. (Masamune does not need to be in the army)

===Default Pokémon===
 
 
===Links===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
====Unobtainable links====
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Start of turn:
When asleep:
"Time to wake up soon, surely."
With low health or a status ailment: 
"Hmm, this is no laughing matter..."
When victory is near:
"Looking good, I'd say!"
Otherwise:
"This is our job, after all..."

Start of battle:
When attacking a castle: 
"I'm more than just a pretty face!"
When defending a castle: 
"May the best man win!"

During battle: 
"Boy, it's tough when you're fighting against women... Especially when they're pretty... Don't you think, ?"

When ordering to attack: 
"It's time!"

When ordering to go to battle: 
To a kingdom:
"All right... Let's see what beautiful flowers are blooming on the battlefield today!"
To a wild Pokémon location:
"I get this feeling like...I'm gonna meet someone really great, you know..."

Upon forming a link: 
"Let's go, !"

When using an item: 
" time!"

When using his Warrior Skill: 
"This should decide it!"

After winning a battle: 
If he attacked a castle:
"What's up? Stunned into silence by this incredibly handsome man?"
If he defended a castle:
"Well, the ladies would have been sad if I'd lost, after all..."

When defeated:
If recruitable:
"Hey! I like the look of you, kinda..."
If defeated by something other than the enemy:
"I did not see that coming."
Otherwise:
"Retreat is as important a battle strategy as any other..."

When being recruited:
"At your service!"

When the player's army has 10 Warriors:
"Hey, we've picked ourselves up quite a few allies. But there's still a lot of work to do... We need more! C'mon, !"

When the player's army has conquered 10 kingdoms:
"Hey, 's army is really coming along... High time we took them down a notch, I reckon!"

===Profile===
A sensible and uncomplicated Warrior who doesn't get hung up on trifles. He does, however, have a great love of women and will attempt to speak to any lady who passes his way.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon + Nobunaga's Ambition ~ Ranse's Color Picture Scroll ~===
Magoichi debuted in PNA6.
 
====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Magoichi is the only Warlord with a completely unique transformation requirement. All other Warlords share some aspect of the requirement with another.

===Historical origin===
Magoichi is based on the real-life of Japanese history, although the name itself is a moniker for at least three individuals, all whom were leaders of the . His relationship to Masamune in Conquest may suggest that he is based on Suzuki Shigetomo specifically.

His Flying type specialty in Conquest may reference his service under Masamune.
